hero.subtitle: I architect intelligent workflows — from LLM agents to enterprise automations — and ship them on Flutter, Firebase and the cloud.

about.headline: A logical thinker with a fail-first, fix-fast personality.
about.body: Software Engineer with 5 years of experience implementing automation projects — from cash-application consulting at HighRadius, to business automation at Axelerant, to my current role driving end-to-end student onboarding automation at Contour Education. I co-founded a startup in my second year of engineering, work as an AI engineer on LLM agents with RAG, and ship Flutter, Shopify and Firebase products on the side. Outside of work, I do stand-up comedy as a full-time hobby.
